user.title: Connect to Amway Atmosphere
user.description:
Please enter your registered Amway mobile phone number and password to connect your Atmosphere purifier.
The integration emulates the official Healthy Home App to authenticate and obtain permanent tokens automatically.

(If you prefer to enter an official authorization code or existing Access Token, you can also fill the optional fields below)

manual_code.title: Access Token or Authorization Code
manual_code.description: Please paste your existing Access Token or Authorization Code below:

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Amway Account
reauth_confirm.description: Please enter your password to re-authenticate account {username}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Amway cloud servers.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid phone number or password. Please verify your credentials.
error.invalid_username: Please enter a valid phone number.
error.missing_credentials_or_token: Please enter Phone Number & Password, Authorization Code, or Access Token.
error.no_devices_found: No Atmosphere air purifiers found. Please make sure your purifier is paired in the official Amway Healthy Home App.

abort.already_configured: This Amway device or account is already configured.
